title: A larger temperature change
hook: Change temperature change and predict heat needed.
misconception: heat needed stays fixed when temperature change doubles.
objective: Apply Q = mcΔT to compare heat needed when temperature change changes, under the stated assumptions.

claims.text: With a fixed mass with constant specific heat and no phase transition, Q = mcΔT. When temperature change doubles, heat needed becomes 2 times its original value.
claims.source: Idealized model Q = mcΔT; scaling exponent 1. Physics and assumptions await independent review.

recall.question: Consider a fixed mass with constant specific heat and no phase transition, with a nonzero initial result. If temperature change triples from a positive value, what is the multiplier on heat needed?
recall.why: Apply Q = mcΔT under the same assumptions: the multiplier is 3.
